brief: Landing page for our SaaS: Fatura.io, invoicing and expense tracking for freelancers in Turkey and the EU. E-invoice (e-Fatura) integration, multi-currency, automatic reminders. Free plan + Pro. Clean modern startup look.

sections.goal: Floating pill navbar with Fatura.io logo, Features, Pricing, FAQ links and Start free button, mobile ☰ menu
Centered headline about getting paid faster in TRY and EUR, Start free and See pricing buttons, product screenshot
Logo strip: integrates with GİB e-Fatura, iyzico, Stripe, Wise and Paraşüt
Bento grid: e-Fatura in one click, multi-currency, automatic payment reminders, expense scanning, tax reports
Free vs Pro €9/month vs Team €29/month comparison table with invoices, currencies, reminders, users
Questions about e-Fatura legality, data location, cancelling and VAT
Multi-column footer with product links, company links, newsletter field and copyright year
